ns2:course.label: Promotional Strategy
ns2:course.description: Familiarizes students with the topic of marketing communications and promotion management, and will teach students the steps for strategically planning a strategic brand communications campaign. The culmination of this course will be a campaign for a real-world client. 3 graduate hours. No professional credit. Credit is not given for both SBC 508 and SBC 507. Prerequisite: Restricted to MS: SBC students.
